standardsRefs: Ready for Life v1, Grade 4 Unit 2: Clothing and Laundry Care
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice supervised machine loading. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: With a trusted adult present, you take one already-sorted group of laundry to the washing machine and run the whole loading sequence yourself, choosing settings, loading the drum, and measuring detergent, while your adult checks each decision before you press start.
safetyNotes: A trusted adult stays present for the entire loading sequence and confirms the water temperature, cycle, and detergent amount before the learner presses start.
Do not overfill the drum past the machine's fill line; an overloaded load can unbalance the machine or stop items from washing properly.
Measure detergent using the marked line on the cap or dispenser rather than guessing, and check with the adult before touching any bleach or stain-treatment product.

simulationAlternative.description: If a working washing machine is not available, the learner instead studies a picture or diagram of a washing machine control panel alongside a description of an already-sorted laundry group, then writes out every decision they would make in order (temperature, cycle, load size, detergent amount) and the specific reason for each, checked by a trusted adult in their household for accuracy.

materials: learner-local: one sorted group of laundry ready to wash
adult-or-local: access to a real washing machine
learner-local: detergent with a marked measuring line

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one decision in this task that you made yourself for the first time, and explain what you would want to double-check the next time you do this without being reminded.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Setting decisions matched to the sorted group: Temperature, cycle, and detergent amount are all chosen correctly for the sorted group and confirmed by the adult before the cycle starts. | Load-size reasoning: The explanation correctly identifies a specific problem, such as poor rinsing, an unbalanced machine, or an ineffective wash, that would result from doubling the load. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner run a second load with a different sorted group, for example a delicates group after washing a sturdy-darks group, and write a short comparison of how their three setting decisions changed between the two loads and why.

resources.title: supervised machine loading worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: With a trusted adult present, you take one already-sorted group of laundry to the washing machine and run the whole loading sequence yourself, choosing settings, loading the drum, and measuring detergent, while your adult checks each decision before you press start.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact supervised machine loading decision or action.
Model move 2: Before touching the machine, look at your sorted laundry group and the machine's control panel with your adult.
Model move 3: With your adult checking each step, choose the water temperature and cycle for your group, load the drum without overfilling it, and measure the detergent using the marked line.

Model check: Setting decisions matched to the sorted group: Temperature, cycle, and detergent amount are all chosen correctly for the sorted group and confirmed by the adult before the cycle starts. | Load-size reasoning: The explanation correctly identifies a specific problem, such as poor rinsing, an unbalanced machine, or an ineffective wash, that would result from doubling the load.

resources.title: supervised machine loading action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for supervised machine loading.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-guided-card.

resources.title: supervised machine loading coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: With a trusted adult present, you take one already-sorted group of laundry to the washing machine and run the whole loading sequence yourself, choosing settings, loading the drum, and measuring detergent, while your adult checks each decision before you press start.
Coach direction: Before touching the machine, look at your sorted laundry group and the machine's control panel with your adult.
Learner prompt: Describe your laundry group (its color or fabric type) and name the machine setting you think matches it best, before your adult confirms.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: supervised machine loading complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: With your adult checking each step, choose the water temperature and cycle for your group, load the drum without overfilling it, and measure the detergent using the marked line.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I chose a water temperature and cycle that matched my sorted group, and my adult confirmed the choice before I loaded anything.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I loaded the drum loosely enough that items had room to move, not packed to the top.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I measured detergent to the marked line instead of guessing or pouring extra.

Equal-access rule: If a working washing machine is not available, the learner instead studies a picture or diagram of a washing machine control panel alongside a description of an already-sorted laundry group, then writes out every decision they would make in order (temperature, cycle, load size, detergent amount) and the specific reason for each, checked by a trusted adult in their household for accuracy.

resources.title: supervised machine loading minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one decision in this task that you made yourself for the first time, and explain what you would want to double-check the next time you do this without being reminded.

Success checks: Setting decisions matched to the sorted group: Temperature, cycle, and detergent amount are all chosen correctly for the sorted group and confirmed by the adult before the cycle starts. | Load-size reasoning: The explanation correctly identifies a specific problem, such as poor rinsing, an unbalanced machine, or an ineffective wash, that would result from doubling the load.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: supervised machine loading supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional supervised machine loading condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Setting decisions matched to the sorted group: Temperature, cycle, and detergent amount are all chosen correctly for the sorted group and confirmed by the adult before the cycle starts. | Load-size reasoning: The explanation correctly identifies a specific problem, such as poor rinsing, an unbalanced machine, or an ineffective wash, that would result from doubling the load..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g4-u02-l03-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Setting decisions matched to the sorted group: Temperature, cycle, and detergent amount are all chosen correctly for the sorted group and confirmed by the adult before the cycle starts. | Load-size reasoning: The explanation correctly identifies a specific problem, such as poor rinsing, an unbalanced machine, or an ineffective wash, that would result from doubling the load.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
